content.sentence: My name is Laura and I live in São Paulo.
content.translation: Meu nome é Laura e eu moro em São Paulo.

content.sentence: I usually wake up at 7 o'clock and take a shower.
content.translation: Eu geralmente acordo às 7 horas e tomo um banho.

content.sentence: After breakfast, I go to work by bus.
content.translation: Depois do café da manhã, eu vou ao trabalho de ônibus.

content.sentence: I work as a teacher and I really enjoy my job.
content.translation: Eu trabalho como professora e realmente gosto do meu trabalho.

content.sentence: In the evening, I cook dinner and watch TV with my family.
content.translation: À noite, eu cozinho o jantar e assisto TV com minha família.

content.sentence: I went to bed at 10:30 last night.
content.translation: Eu fui dormir às 22:30 ontem à noite.

comprehension_questions.question: What time does Laura wake up?
comprehension_questions.explanation: The text says 'I usually wake up at 7 o'clock'.

comprehension_questions.question: How does Laura go to work?
Laura watches TV alone in the evening.
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'I watch TV with my family' — she watches with her family.

content.sentence: Last Monday, I had an important job interview at a big company.
content.translation: Na segunda-feira passada, eu tive uma entrevista de emprego importante em uma grande empresa.

content.sentence: I have worked in marketing for three years.
content.translation: Eu tenho trabalhado em marketing por três anos.

content.sentence: The interviewer asked me about my previous experience.
content.translation: O entrevistador me perguntou sobre minha experiência anterior.

content.sentence: I have never missed a deadline in my career.
content.translation: Eu nunca perdi um prazo na minha carreira.

content.sentence: They offered me the position and I accepted it immediately.
content.translation: Eles me ofereceram a vaga e eu a aceitei imediatamente.

comprehension_questions.question: When did the interview happen?
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'Last Monday, I had an important job interview.'

comprehension_questions.question: How long has the person worked in marketing?
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'I have worked in marketing for three years.'

comprehension_questions.question: The person got the job.
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'They offered me the position and I accepted it.'

content.sentence: Sarah had always dreamed of working for a large marketing company in London.
content.translation: Sarah sempre sonhou em trabalhar para uma grande empresa de marketing em Londres.

vocabulary.note: past perfect — ação anterior a outro momento no passado

content.sentence: When she finally got an interview, she spent two weeks preparing for it.
content.translation: Quando ela finalmente conseguiu uma entrevista, passou duas semanas se preparando.

content.sentence: She researched the company thoroughly and practised answering common interview questions.
content.translation: Ela pesquisou a empresa minuciosamente e praticou responder perguntas comuns de entrevista.

content.sentence: On the morning of the interview, Sarah felt nervous but confident.
content.translation: Na manhã da entrevista, Sarah se sentiu nervosa mas confiante.

content.sentence: She arrived at the office early, which made a good first impression.
content.translation: Ela chegou ao escritório cedo, o que causou uma boa primeira impressão.

vocabulary.note: expressão muito usada em contexto profissional

content.sentence: The interviewer asked her about her previous experience and her greatest achievements.
content.translation: O entrevistador perguntou sobre sua experiência anterior e suas maiores conquistas.

content.sentence: Sarah explained that she had successfully managed a team and never missed a deadline.
content.translation: Sarah explicou que havia gerenciado uma equipe com sucesso e nunca perdera um prazo.

vocabulary.note: miss a deadline = não cumprir o prazo

content.sentence: At the end, she asked about the salary and the possibility of remote work.
content.translation: No final, ela perguntou sobre o salário e a possibilidade de trabalho remoto.

content.sentence: Three days later, the company called to offer her the position, and she accepted immediately.
content.translation: Três dias depois, a empresa ligou para oferecer a vaga, e ela aceitou imediatamente.

comprehension_questions.question: How long did Sarah spend preparing for the interview?
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'She spent two weeks preparing for it.'

comprehension_questions.question: What did Sarah ask at the end of the interview?
options: About the salary and remote work
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'She asked about the salary and the possibility of remote work.'

comprehension_questions.question: Sarah arrived late for the interview.
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'She arrived at the office early, which made a good first impression.'

texts.title: Climate Change and Our Future
texts.title_pt: A Mudança Climática e Nosso Futuro

content.sentence: Climate change is no longer a distant threat — it is happening right now, all around us.
content.translation: A mudança climática não é mais uma ameaça distante — está acontecendo agora, ao nosso redor.

vocabulary.note: expressão de negação de estado anterior

content.sentence: Rising temperatures have caused more frequent droughts, floods, and extreme weather events.
content.translation: O aumento das temperaturas causou secas, enchentes e eventos climáticos extremos mais frequentes.

content.sentence: Scientists agree that the main cause is the burning of fossil fuels, which releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.
content.translation: Cientistas concordam que a principal causa é a queima de combustíveis fósseis, que libera dióxido de carbono na atmosfera.

content.sentence: This intensifies the greenhouse effect and accelerates global warming.
content.translation: Isso intensifica o efeito estufa e acelera o aquecimento global.

content.sentence: Deforestation also makes the problem worse, as trees absorb CO2 from the air.
content.translation: O desmatamento também piora o problema, pois as árvores absorvem CO2 do ar.

content.sentence: In my opinion, governments must take bold action and invest in renewable energy as quickly as possible.
content.translation: Na minha opinião, os governos devem agir com ousadia e investir em energia renovável o mais rápido possível.

vocabulary.note: expressão para introduzir ponto de vista

content.sentence: Each individual can also reduce their carbon footprint by using public transport, recycling, and eating less meat.
content.translation: Cada indivíduo também pode reduzir sua pegada de carbono usando transporte público, reciclando e comendo menos carne.

content.sentence: Biodiversity is also at risk — many species may disappear if we do not act.
content.translation: A biodiversidade também está em risco — muitas espécies podem desaparecer se não agirmos.

content.sentence: Sustainability must become a shared responsibility, not just a government policy.
content.translation: A sustentabilidade deve se tornar uma responsabilidade compartilhada, não apenas uma política governamental.

vocabulary.note: colocação nominal comum em textos de opinião

content.sentence: The decisions we make today will shape the world our children will inherit tomorrow.
content.translation: As decisões que tomamos hoje moldarão o mundo que nossos filhos irão herdar amanhã.

vocabulary.note: verbo metafórico — muito usado em textos formais
verbo regular — receber de gerações anteriores

comprehension_questions.question: According to the text, what is the main cause of climate change?
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'The main cause is the burning of fossil fuels, which releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.'

comprehension_questions.question: Which of the following is mentioned as a way individuals can help?
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'Each individual can reduce their carbon footprint by using public transport, recycling, and eating less meat.'

comprehension_questions.question: The author believes climate change is only a future problem.
comprehension_questions.explanation: 'Climate change is no longer a distant threat — it is happening right now, all around us.'
